item.title: Park Chan-dae "Overwhelming Victory in Incheon, Which Nurtured Lee" vs Yoo Jeong-bok "A True Worker Who Creates Happiness for Citizens" (박찬대 “李 품고 키운 인천에서 압승” vs 유정복 “시민 행복 만들 진짜 일꾼”)
item.description:
Park Chan-dae "Overwhelming Victory in Incheon, Which Nurtured Lee" vs Yoo Jeong-bok "A True Worker Who Creates Happiness for Citizens" (박찬대 “李 품고 키운 인천에서 압승” vs 유정복 “시민 행복 만들 진짜 일꾼”)

On the 21st, when the official campaign for the June 3 Incheon mayoral election began, all three candidates—former Democratic Party floor leader Park Chan-dae, incumbent People Power Party Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok, and Reform Party Incheon City Chapter Chairman Lee Gi-bung—held kickoff rallies, vowing election victory. (6·3 인천시장 선거 공식 선거운동이 시작된 21일 더불어민주당 박찬대 전 원내대표와 국민의힘 유정복 현 시장, 개혁신당 이기붕 시당위원장 등 출마 후보 3명은 모두 출정식을 열고 선거 승리를 다짐했다.)

Democratic Party former floor leader Park Chan-dae held his kickoff rally at the old Citizens' Hall shelter in Michuhol-gu, near the election campaign office. (민주당 박찬대 전 원내대표는 이날 선거 캠프 사무실 인근인 미추홀구 옛 시민회관 쉼터에서 출정식을 열었다.)

Attendees at the rally included National Assembly members Kim Kyo-heung, Maeng Seong-gyu, and Yoo Dong-su, who serve as Park's general election committee chairs, along with Incheon-area lawmakers and Democratic Party candidates for head of basic local governments, all pledging to unite as one team for victory. (출정식에는 박 전 대표 총괄선거대책위원장인 김교흥, 맹성규, 유동수 의원을 비롯한 인천 지역 국회의원과 민주당 기초단체장 후보들이 참석해 선거 승리를 위해 ‘원팀’으로 함께하겠다는 의지를 다졌다.)

In his campaign speech, Park said, "Incheon is the No. 1 political district in South Korea that embraced and raised President Lee Jae-myung, and it is the heart of the Lee Jae-myung administration," adding, "We will create a massive wave in Incheon, which received the Democratic Party's first nomination letter in the Seoul metropolitan area, leading to an overwhelming victory across South Korea." He continued, "I will unite tightly as one team with the 11 candidates for heads of basic local governments in Incheon to make the city's heart pound as if it will burst," and pledged, "I will become a mayor focused on people's livelihoods and the economy, innovating city governance that is all talk and no action, and bringing prosperity to the struggling household finances." (박 전 대표는 출정사에서 “인천은 이재명 대통령을 품고 키워낸 대한민국 정치 1번지이자 이재명 정부의 심장”이라며 “민주당의 수도권 1호 공천장을 받은 인천에서 거대한 돌풍을 일으켜 대한민국 전체의 압승을 이끌겠다”고 했다. 이어 “11명의 인천 지역 기초단체장 후보와 함께 원팀으로 똘똘 뭉쳐 인천의 심장을 터질 듯이 뛰게 하겠다”며 “말만 무성하고 실행력 없는 시정을 혁신하고, 팍팍한 살림살이에 풍년이 들게 하는 민생·경제 시장이 되겠다”고 했다.)

People Power Party Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok held his kickoff rally at Songdo Station in Yeonsu-gu, launching his campaign. (국민의힘 유정복 시장은 이날 연수구 송도역에서 출정식을 열고 선거운동에 나섰다.)

The rally was attended by former Deputy Prime Minister for Social Affairs Hwang Woo-yeo, who serves as chairman of Yoo's election committee, National Assembly member Yoon Sang-hyun, along with candidates for the National Assembly by-election and heads of basic local governments, who rallied for Yoo's victory. (출정식엔 유 시장 선거대책위원회 의장인 황우여 전 사회부총리와 윤상현 국회의원을 비롯해 국회의원 보궐선거, 기초단체장 선거 후보자 등이 참석해 유 시장의 승리를 응원했다.)

Mayor Yoo stated, "I am also starting from Incheon's KTX departure station, which changes Incheon's history," adding, "We must choose the true worker between someone who disrespects citizens with lies and a genuine worker who works only for citizens, and create our happy future ourselves." (유 시장은 “인천의 역사를 바꾸는 인천발 KTX 출발역에서 저도 출발한다”며 “거짓말로 시민을 무시하는 사람과 오직 시민만을 위해 일하는 진정한 일꾼 중 진짜 일꾼을 선택해 우리의 행복한 미래를 스스로 만들어야 한다”고 했다.)

Reform Party Incheon City Chapter Chairman Lee Gi-bung held his kickoff rally near Okryeon Market in Yeonsu-gu. (개혁신당 이기붕 시당위원장은 연수구 옥련시장 인근에서 출정식을 열었다.)

Lee, joined by floor leader Cheon Ha-ram and candidates for the National Assembly by-election and district councilors, plans to begin his campaign schedule in the Yeonsu-gu and Namdong-gu areas. <<>> (천하람 원내대표와 국회의원 보궐선거, 구의원 후보 등이 함께 출정식을 가진 이 위원장은 연수구와 남동구 일대를 시작으로 유세 일정을 진행할 계획이다.)

item.title: June 3 Local Elections Officially Kick Off: Rival Parties in North Chungcheong Hold Campaign Kickoffs in Battle for Voter Support (6·3 지방선거 공식 개막… 충북 여야 출정식 “표심 쟁탈전”)
item.description:
June 3 Local Elections Officially Kick Off: Rival Parties in North Chungcheong Hold Campaign Kickoffs in Battle for Voter Support (6·3 지방선거 공식 개막… 충북 여야 출정식 “표심 쟁탈전”)

On the 21st, as the official campaign period for the June 3 local elections began, rival party candidates and education superintendent candidates in North Chungcheong Province held kickoff rallies, entering a full-fledged 13-day election race. Each candidate appealed for support by highlighting themes such as "North Chungcheong's future," "checks on the administration," and "Cheongju's great transformation." (6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동이 시작된 21일 충북 여야와 교육감 후보들이 일제히 출정식을 열고 13일간의 본격 선거전에 돌입했다. 각 후보들은 “충북의 미래”, “정권 견제”, “청주 대전환” 등을 내세우며 지지를 호소했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea’s North Chungcheong Provincial Committee held its campaign kickoff rally that morning at the plaza in front of Cheongju Gymnasium, rallying support. The event drew around 500 participants, including Shin Yong-han, the party’s candidate for North Chungcheong governor; Lee Jang-seop, its candidate for Cheongju mayor; candidates for metropolitan and basic council seats; party members; and supporters. (더불어민주당 충북도당은 이날 오전 청주체육관 앞 광장에서 출정식을 열고 세 결집에 나섰다. 행사에는 신용한 충북지사 후보와 이장섭 청주시장 후보를 비롯해 광역·기초의원 후보, 당원·지지자 등 500여 명이 참석했다.)

Honorary election committee chair Lee Si-jong appealed, saying, "To successfully push forward North Chungcheong’s long-cherished projects, please overwhelmingly elect the Democratic Party candidates." Standing election committee chair Im Ho-seon also stated, "This is a crucial election to move the stagnant North Chungcheong forward again," adding, "We will create changes that residents can feel." (이시종 명예선대위원장은 “충북의 숙원 사업을 성공적으로 추진하기 위해 민주당 후보들을 압도적으로 당선시켜 달라”고 호소했다. 임호선 상임선대위원장도 “정체된 충북을 다시 앞으로 나아가게 할 중요한 선거”라며 “도민이 체감할 수 있는 변화를 만들겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Shin said, "I will change the landscape of North Chungcheong and prove it with results," vowing to "end showpiece politics and administration and open a new era for North Chungcheong through competence." Candidate Lee emphasized, "I will end unilateral and uncommunicative administration and reawaken Cheongju’s stalled growth engine," adding, "I will create a vibrant Cheongju that the 880,000 citizens can truly feel." (신 후보는 “충북의 판을 바꾸고 결과로 증명하겠다”며 “보여주기식 정치와 행정을 끝내고 실력으로 충북의 새로운 시대를 열겠다”고 말했다. 이 후보는 “독단과 불통 행정을 끝내고 멈춰 선 청주의 성장 동력을 다시 깨우겠다”며 “88만 시민이 체감하는 활력 넘치는 청주를 만들겠다”고 강조했다.)

The People Power Party’s North Chungcheong Provincial Committee also held its campaign kickoff rally that day at the plaza in front of the former Lotte Cinema on Seongan-gil in Cheongju, beginning its full-scale canvassing. Around 300 people attended, including Kim Young-hwan, the party’s candidate for North Chungcheong governor; Lee Beom-seok, its candidate for Cheongju mayor; candidates for metropolitan and basic council seats; and party members. (국민의힘 충북도당도 이날 청주 성안길 옛 롯데시네마 앞 광장에서 출정식을 열고 본격 표밭갈이에 나섰다. 행사에는 김영환 충북지사 후보와 이범석 청주시장 후보, 광역·기초의원 후보, 당원 등 300여 명이 참석했다.)

Ahead of the rally, the People Power Party paid respects at the Chungnyeongtap monument in Ochang Central Neighborhood Park to bolster their determination to win. Standing election committee chair Eom Tae-young said, "For the future of South Korea and the development of North Chungcheong, please rally behind the People Power Party." (국민의힘은 출정식에 앞서 오창중앙근린공원 충혼탑을 참배하며 필승 의지를 다졌다. 엄태영 상임선대위원장은 “대한민국의 미래와 충북 발전을 위해 국민의힘에 힘을 모아달라”고 말했다.)

Candidate Kim stated, "The Democratic Party is fielding a candidate dogged by allegations of election fraud," and vowed to "block the arrogant politics that neglect North Chungcheong and build a stronger province." Candidate Lee said, "During the 8th term of local governance, we achieved results in investment attraction and urban growth," adding, "The next four years will be the time to complete major projects that will determine Cheongju’s fate." He emphasized, "I will complete Cheongju as a self-sufficient city of one million, a global premier city, and a city full of fun." (김 후보는 “민주당이 부정 선거 의혹을 받는 후보를 내세우고 있다”며 “충북을 홀대하는 오만한 정치를 막아내고 더 강한 충북을 만들겠다”고 했다. 이 후보는 “민선 8기 동안 투자 유치와 도시 성장 등 성과를 냈다”며 “다음 4년은 청주의 명운이 걸린 대형 프로젝트를 완성할 시점”이라고 말했다. 이어 “100만 자족 도시, 글로벌 명품 도시, 꿀잼 도시 청주를 완성하겠다”고 강조했다.)

Street campaigning and kickoff rallies by candidates from both parties also continued in various cities and counties, including Chungju, Goesan, Boeun, Okcheon, Yeongdong, Jincheon, and Eumseong. (충주·괴산·보은·옥천·영동·진천·음성 등 각 시·군에서도 여야 후보들의 거리 유세와 출정식이 이어졌다.)

The Progressive Party’s North Chungcheong Provincial Committee, instead of holding a separate kickoff rally, held a press conference in front of a Starbucks near the provincial government complex in Cheongju to join the boycott movement related to the recent controversy over "disparaging marketing of the May 18 Democratization Movement." The Progressive Party stated, "We will check the two-party monopoly and create transparent politics in North Chungcheong." (진보당 충북도당은 별도 출정식 대신 청주 도청 인근 스타벅스 매장 앞에서 기자회견을 열고 최근 불거진 ‘5·18 비하 마케팅’ 논란과 관련한 불매운동에 동참했다. 진보당은 “양당 독점 구조를 견제하고 투명한 충북 정치를 만들겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Candidates in the three-way race for North Chungcheong Superintendent of Education also began their full-scale campaigns. Candidate Kim Sung-geun held a kickoff rally at the intersection near Chungbuk National University in Cheongju, while candidate Kim Jin-kyun held one in Yeonsu-dong, Chungju, appealing for support. Incumbent candidate Yoon Gun-young, seeking re-election, also held a kickoff rally at the Bongmyeong intersection in Cheongju, stating, "I will continue the stable innovation of North Chungcheong’s education." (3파전으로 치러지는 충북교육감 선거 후보들도 본격 세몰이에 나섰다. 김성근 후보는 청주 충북대 사거리에서, 김진균 후보는 충주 연수동에서 각각 출정식을 열고 지지를 호소했다. 재선에 도전하는 윤건영 후보 역시 청주 봉명사거리에서 출정식을 열고 “충북 교육의 안정적 혁신을 이어가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

In this local election, North Chungcheong Province will elect a total of 191 officials: one governor, one education superintendent, 11 city mayors and county governors, 38 metropolitan council members, and 140 basic council members. A total of 349 candidates are running. (이번 지방선거에서 충북에서는 도지사 1명, 교육감 1명, 시장·군수 11명, 광역의원 38명, 기초의원 140명 등 모두 191명을 선출한다. 총 출마자는 349명이다.)

item.title: Government to crack down on 'gift certificate loan sharks' as illegal private financing (정부, ‘상품권 사채’도 불법 사금융 취급해 단속한다)
item.description:
Government to crack down on 'gift certificate loan sharks' as illegal private financing (정부, ‘상품권 사채’도 불법 사금융 취급해 단속한다)

The government has decided to treat high-interest lending through so-called 'gift certificate pre-sale' schemes as illegal private financing and take action accordingly. (정부가 이른바 ‘상품권 예약 판매’ 수법의 고리대금도 불법 사금융으로 보고 대응하기로 했다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination announced on the 21st that this decision was made at a 'Pan-Government Task Force (TF) Meeting for Eradicating Illegal Private Financing' chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Yoon Chang-ryeol. The meeting was attended by officials from the Financial Services Commission, Ministry of Justice, Supreme Prosecutors' Office, National Police Agency, Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission, Korea Communications Standards Commission, Financial Supervisory Service, Korea Legal Aid Corporation, the Korea Inclusive Finance Agency, and the Credit Counseling and Recovery Service. (국무총리실은 21일 윤창렬 국무조정실장 주재로 ‘불법 사금융 근절을 위한 범정부 TF’ 회의를 열어 이같이 결정했다고 밝혔다. 이날 회의에는 금융위원회, 법무부, 대검찰청, 경찰청, 방송미디어통신위원회, 방송미디어통신심의위원회, 금융감독원, 법률구조공단, 서민금융진흥원, 신용회복위원회 관계자들이 참석했다.)

A gift certificate pre-sale involves a person in urgent need of cash making a contract to sell gift certificates to an illegal loan shark. The loan shark pays the 'gift certificate price' in advance, and the borrower later repays it with gift certificates at high interest. This is a new type of loan sharking that emerged as crackdowns on illegal lending intensified. The TF stated, "This new type of illegal private financing is rapidly spreading through internet cafes and social media. As it outwardly appears to be a normal contract, when the victim fails to redeem the gift certificates, the illegal loan shark threatens the victim by claiming they were 'defrauded in a gift certificate transaction' and even files a fraud complaint with the police." (상품권 예약 판매는 급전이 필요한 사람이 불법 사채업자에게 상품권을 팔기로 하는 계약을 맺고, 사채업자가 미리 ‘상품권 대금’을 주면 나중에 높은 이자를 붙여 상품권으로 갚는 것이다. 불법 사채 단속이 강화되자 나타난 신종 사채다. TF는 “최근 인터넷 카페와 소셜미디어 등을 경유해 이런 신종 불법 사금융이 급속도로 확산되고 있다”며 “외관상 정상적인 계약 형태를 띠다 보니 피해자가 상품권 미상환 시 불법 사채업자가 ‘상품권 거래 사기를 당했다’며 피해자를 오히려 협박하고, 경찰에 사기죄로 고소하는 일이 벌어지고 있다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 12th, President Lee Jae-myung said at a Cabinet meeting, "I saw a report about someone being lent 500,000 won and having to repay 800,000 won in gift certificates within nine days. This is a clear violation of the Interest Limitation Act. It is not only void but also subject to punishment." The government announced its countermeasures nine days after this remark. (앞서 지난 12일 이재명 대통령은 국무회의에서 “50만원 대출해 주고 9일 만에 80만원을 상품권으로 받는다는 기사도 있더라”며 “명백히 이자제한법 위반이다. 무효인 데다 처벌 대상”이라고 말했다. 정부가 이로부터 아흐레 만에 대책을 내놓은 것이다.)

At the meeting, the TF decided, "Even if a gift certificate pre-sale outwardly disguises itself as a sale of gift certificates, the Loan Business Act applies when considering the substance of the transaction. If such transactions are conducted repeatedly without registering as a loan business, the perpetrator will be regarded as an illegal private financier and dealt with strongly." (TF는 이날 회의에서 “상품권 예약 판매는 외관상 상품권 매매를 가장하더라도, 거래 실질을 고려해 대부업법이 적용된다”며 “대부업 등록 없이 반복적으로 상품권 예약 판매 거래를 하는 경우에는 불법 사금융업자로 보고 강력히 대응”하기로 했다.)

Accordingly, the TF decided to provide victims of gift certificate pre-sales with the government's 'one-stop support', identical to that offered to general victims of illegal private financing. Once a victim reports the damage to the government, a dedicated caseworker is immediately assigned. The Financial Supervisory Service issues a confirmation that loan contracts exceeding an annual interest rate of 60% are invalid, and the government warns the illegal financier of its involvement. (이에 따라 TF는 상품권 예약 판매 피해자에게도 일반 불법 사금융 피해자와 동일하게 정부의 ‘원스톱 지원’을 제공하기로 했다. 피해자가 정부에 피해 사실을 신고하기만 하면, 즉시 담당자를 배정하고, 금융감독원은 연리 60%를 초과하는 대부 계약이 무효라는 확인서를 발급해주고, 해당 불법 사금융업자에게 정부 개입 사실을 경고하는 것이다.)

Furthermore, the TF decided that if an illegal financier files a fraud complaint against the victim, the government will support the victim's legal defense through the Korea Legal Aid Corporation. Even if the victim has already received a final conviction for fraud, the legal aid corporation will assist with a separate lawsuit to ensure the victim does not have to pay the illegal financier. (TF는 또 불법 사금융업자가 피해자를 ‘사기 피의자’로 고소한 경우에는 법률구조공단을 통해 피해자의 소송을 돕고, 피해자가 이미 사기죄로 확정 판결을 받은 경우에도 불법 사금융업자에게 돈을 물어주지 않아도 되도록 법률구조공단을 통해 별도 소송을 지원하기로 했다.)

The TF also decided that, as some internet cafes are acting as intermediaries for this new type of loan sharking, measures will be taken to shut down related cafes, prohibit the creation of similar cafes, and expand investigations into cafe operators. (TF는 인터넷 카페 일부가 이 신종 사채를 중개하고 있다고 보고, 관련 카페 폐쇄, 유사 카페 개설 금지, 카페 운영자 수사 확대 등의 조치를 하기로 했다.)

TF head Yoon Chang-ryeol stated, "As new forms of irregular illegal private financing may continue to emerge, the government will actively respond by focusing on the substance of the transactions rather than their form, thoroughly cracking down on crimes and ensuring victims are provided relief." (TF 단장인 윤창렬 국조실장은 “앞으로도 변칙적인 신종 불법 사금융 행태가 나타날 수 있는 만큼, 거래 형식보다 실질에 주목해 범죄를 철저히 단속하고 피해자가 구제될 수 있도록 정부가 적극 대응할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: “We Will Complete the Large-Scale Cultural Shopping Mall Early”… Kim Young-hwan and Lee Beom-seok Announce Joint Pledges (“대형 문화쇼핑몰 조기 완공하겠다”... 김영환·이범석 공동공약 발표)
item.description:
“We Will Complete the Large-Scale Cultural Shopping Mall Early”… Kim Young-hwan and Lee Beom-seok Announce Joint Pledges (“대형 문화쇼핑몰 조기 완공하겠다”... 김영환·이범석 공동공약 발표)

On the first day of the official campaign for the June 3 local elections, Kim Young-hwan, the People Power Party candidate for governor of North Chungcheong Province, and Lee Beom-seok, the candidate for mayor of Cheongju, announced joint pledges on the 21st. The two candidates appealed for support, stating, “We will develop Cheongju into a key city in the central region of South Korea.” (6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 첫날인 21일 국민의힘 김영환 충북지사 후보와 이범석 청주시장 후보가 공동 공약을 발표했다. 두 후보는 “청주를 대한민국 중부권 핵심 도시로 키우겠다”며 지지를 호소했다.)

The two candidates held a press conference at the North Chungcheong Provincial Government briefing room that day, unveiling pledges in the areas of development, transportation, healthcare, and culture. They also emphasized the “one-team” collaboration between the province and the city. (두 후보는 이날 충북도청 브리핑룸에서 기자회견을 열고 개발·교통·의료·문화 분야 공약을 공개했다. 충북도와 청주시의 ‘원팀’ 협업도 강조했다.)

First, they promised the early completion of a Starfield-level large-scale cultural shopping mall. The candidates said, “We will change the reality where Cheongju residents have to go to other regions due to insufficient cultural and shopping infrastructure.” (우선 스타필드급 대형 문화쇼핑몰의 조기 완공을 약속했다. 두 후보는 “청주시민들이 문화·쇼핑 인프라 부족으로 다른 지역으로 가야 하는 현실을 바꾸겠다”고 말했다.)

They also proposed expanding youth entrepreneurship education and tailored support, creating a complex cultural library and a cultural arts street, and developing the Cheongju Prison site into a smart eco-city. (청년 창업교육과 맞춤형 지원 확대, 복합문화도서관·문화예술거리 조성, 청주교도소 부지 스마트생태도시 개발 계획도 내놨다.)

In the healthcare sector, they announced plans to expand medical personnel and introduce a government responsibility system. The candidates said, “We will expand provincial and municipal budgets to build a regional medical safety net.” (의료 분야에서는 의료 인력 확충과 정부 책임제 도입을 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 두 후보는 “도정·시정 예산을 확대해 지역 의료 안전망을 구축하겠다”고 했다.)

They also presented pledges in transportation and industry. These include constructing a dome stadium, building a new civilian-only runway at Cheongju International Airport, early completion of Osong K-Bio Square, double-track electrification of the Cheonan–Cheongju Airport line and extension of the metropolitan subway, and the rapid start of construction on the Chungcheong Regional Express Railway (CTX). (교통·산업 공약도 제시했다. 돔구장 건설, 청주국제공항 민간 전용 활주로 신설, 오송 K바이오스퀘어 조기 완성, 천안~청주공항 복선 전철화와 수도권 전철 연장, 충청권 광역 급행철도(CTX) 조속 착공 등이다.)

The two candidates said, “If North Chungcheong Province and Cheongju City move as one team, the feasibility of these pledges becomes even greater,” adding, “We will surely prove Cheongju’s change and leap forward.” (두 후보는 “충북도와 청주시가 원팀으로 움직이면 공약 실현 가능성은 더 커진다”며 “청주의 변화와 도약을 반드시 증명하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: ‘Smart City’ Project with 1 Trillion Won Investment Sees Nearly Half of Major Services Suspended (1조원 들어간 ‘스마트 도시’, 주요 사업 절반 가까이 서비스 중단)
item.description:
‘Smart City’ Project with 1 Trillion Won Investment Sees Nearly Half of Major Services Suspended (1조원 들어간 ‘스마트 도시’, 주요 사업 절반 가까이 서비스 중단)

The government’s ‘Smart City Development and Expansion Project,’ which has invested over 1 trillion won since 2019, has resulted in more than 100 billion won in budget waste. This initiative, launched as part of the Moon Jae-in administration’s ‘Green New Deal’ policy aimed at creating ‘carbon-neutral cities,’ has continued under subsequent governments. In the past five years alone, from 2021 to last year, 797 billion won has been allocated to the project. However, repeated criticisms have been raised about its poor performance and inadequate management and operation. (정부가 2019년부터 1조원 이상 투입한 ‘스마트 도시 조성·확산 사업’에서 1000억원 넘는 예산 낭비가 있었던 것으로 드러났다. 스마트 도시 사업은 문재인 정부가 ‘탄소 중립 도시’를 만들겠다며 ‘그린 뉴딜’ 정책의 하나로 시작한 사업으로, 이후 정부에서도 계속됐다. 2021년부터 지난해까지 최근 5년간 투입된 예산만 7970억원에 이른다. 그러나 사업 성과가 저조하고 관리·운영이 부실하다는 지적이 거듭 제기돼 왔다.)

On the 21st, the Government Joint Anti-Corruption Task Force under the Office for Government Policy Coordination, along with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, announced that, after conducting intensive inspections of 121 projects across 13 local governments involved in related initiatives, they uncovered 309 cases of legal violations or improprieties. (국무조정실 정부합동 부패예방추진단과 국토교통부는 관련 사업을 수행한 지방정부 가운데 13곳의 121개 사업을 집중 점검한 결과, 309건의 위법·부적정 사례를 적발했다고 21일 밝혔다.)

According to the task force, among the 121 projects, 52 (43.0%) projects, which cost 104.6 billion won, either remained incomplete or saw budget waste due to insufficient preparation, and poor operation and management. One local government launched 10 projects, including ‘demand-responsive buses’ and ‘intelligent ride-sharing taxis,’ at a cost of 11.1 billion won, but terminated the services after just two years and five months due to low usage and excessive operational costs. Another local government invested 11 billion won in five projects, such as ‘building a real-time traffic information collection infrastructure’ and ‘implementing an AI-based traffic signal system,’ but these remain unused as consultations with the National Police Agency, which oversees traffic signals, have been delayed. (추진단에 따르면, 121개 사업 가운데 1046억원이 들어간 52개(43.0%) 사업은 사업이 완료되지 못했거나, 준비 부족, 운영·관리 부실로 예산이 낭비됐다. 한 지방정부는 111억원을 들여 ‘수요 응답형 버스’ ‘지능형 합승 택시’ 등 10개 사업을 벌였으나, 이용 실적이 저조하고 운영비가 과다하다는 이유로 2년 5개월 만에 서비스를 종료했다. 다른 지방정부는 110억원을 들여 ‘실시간 교통 정보 수집 인프라 구축’ ‘AI(인공지능) 기반 교통 신호 체계 구현’ 등 5개 사업을 했으나, 교통 신호 체계를 담당하는 경찰청과의 협의가 지연되면서 실제로 쓰이지 못하고 있다.)

Yet another local government spent 20 billion won on 11 projects, including ‘demand-responsive buses,’ ‘ultra-compact electric vehicles,’ and ‘shared mobility services.’ However, after local transport companies opposed the initiative due to concerns over declining profitability, the projects were halted just one year and seven months later. One local government invested 10.2 billion won to develop a smartphone app and parking-sharing platform that provided parking information near destinations, launching operations in January 2023. However, the app can no longer be found in the app store, leaving it inoperable and abandoned without maintenance. (또 다른 지방정부는 200억원을 들여 ‘수요 응답형 버스’ ‘초소형 전기차’ ‘공유 모빌리티’ 등 11개 사업을 벌였는데, 지역 운수업체들이 수익성 저하를 우려해 반발하자 1년 7개월 만에 사업을 중단해 버렸다. 한 지방정부는 102억원을 투입해 목적지 주변의 주차장 정보를 얻을 수 있는 스마트폰 앱과 주차 공유 플랫폼을 만들고 2023년 1월 운영을 시작했으나, 현재는 마켓에서 앱이 검색되지 않는 등 사용 불가 상태인데도 관리 없이 방치되고 있다.)

A total of 229 cases of legal violations were also identified in the contracting process between local governments and private operators, involving a total budget of 33.9 billion won. One private operator, while undertaking ‘barrier-free navigation construction projects’ with multiple local governments, split the purchase cost of related components into amounts under 20 million won, treating them as 28 separate contracts. This was done to avoid competitive bidding and secure sole contracts. Meanwhile, one local government, when outsourcing a software development project to a private entity, arbitrarily reduced the project period from 120 days to 70 days—skipping the assessment required by outsourcing guidelines—and issued a tender notice without attaching the assessment document, violating relevant regulations. (지방정부와 민간 사업자 간 계약 과정에서 법규를 어긴 경우도 229건 적발됐다. 관련 사업들에 들어간 예산은 총 339억원이었다. 한 민간 사업자는 지방정부들과 ‘배리어프리 내비게이션 구축 사업’을 하면서 관련 부품 구매액을 2000만원 이하로 쪼개, 28개의 서로 다른 사업인 것처럼 계약했다. 경쟁 입찰을 피하고 수의 계약을 해 사업을 독차지하기 위해서였다. 한 지방정부는 소프트웨어 개발 사업 용역을 민간에 맡기면서, 용역 지침에 따라 산정한 사업 기간을 120일에서 70일로 임의 축소하고, 산정서를 첨부하지 않은 채 입찰 공고를 내는 등 관련 지침을 어겼다.)

There were also 13 cases, totaling 1.12478 billion won, where private operators fraudulently obtained project funds or local governments misused them. One private operator received duplicate funding for a single research and development project by applying simultaneously under the Smart City R&D initiative and a different government agency’s R&D program. Another local government set up a 500 million won project to generate electricity via solar power for charging electric motorcycle batteries, but was caught using the electricity to operate its subordinate timber cooperative instead. (민간 사업자들이 사업비를 부정하게 타내거나, 지방정부가 사업비를 엉뚱한 곳에 쓴 사례도 13건, 11억2478만원어치 적발됐다. 한 민간 사업자는 한 건의 연구·개발을 놓고 스마트 도시 사업 연구·개발 과제와 다른 정부 부처의 연구·개발 과제를 동시에 받아 양쪽에서 사업비를 타냈다. 한 지방정부는 태양광 발전으로 전기를 생산해 전동 오토바이 배터리 충전에 쓰겠다며 5억원짜리 사업을 해놓고, 여기서 나온 전기를 산하 목재협동조합의 운영에 썼다가 적발됐다.)

The task force and the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport have decided to strengthen project selection evaluations to ensure that market analysis and consultations with relevant agencies are fully conducted from the project planning stage, and to improve the system so that private operators bear appropriate responsibility for the projects. In particular, when a local government forms a consortium with a private operator to draft a project plan, a separate feasibility study designated by the ministry must be conducted to verify the plan. (추진단과 국토부는 사업 계획 단계에서부터 시장 분석 및 관계 기관과의 협의가 충분히 이뤄지도록 사업 선정 평가를 강화하고, 민간 사업자가 사업과 관련해 적절한 책임을 지도록 제도를 개선하기로 했다. 특히 지방정부가 민간 사업자와 컨소시엄을 구성해 사업 계획서를 작성한 경우, 반드시 국토부가 지정한 별도 기관의 타당성 조사를 통해 사업 계획서를 검증하기로 했다.)

Additionally, to prevent a single contract manager in a local government from arbitrarily entering into contracts with private operators, the tasks of requesting contracts and approving contracts will be assigned to different public officials. Penalties will also be imposed if private operators fail to submit progress reports or settlement reports on time. Meanwhile, two local government officials found to have improperly diverted project funds will be disciplined, and 1.56454 billion won in project funds will be recovered from private operators who misused them. (또 지방정부의 계약 담당자 한 사람이 임의로 민간 사업자와 계약하지 못하도록, 계약 요청 업무와 계약 승인 업무를 서로 다른 공무원이 수행하도록 하고, 민간 사업자가 실적 보고서, 정산 보고서 등을 제때 제출하지 않을 경우 제재하기로 했다. 한편 사업비를 부당하게 전용한 것으로 드러난 지방정부 공무원 2명을 문책하고, 사업비를 부적정하게 쓴 민간 사업자들로부터는 사업비 15억6454만원을 환수하기로 했다.)

The task force stated, “We will promptly implement follow-up measures, including fund recovery and disciplinary actions, based on the findings of this inspection.” It added, “We will operate the system for budgeting and execution of subsidies more transparently and rigorously, and actively strive to ensure that the Smart City project creates solid infrastructure that addresses real urban issues and enhances citizen convenience.” (추진단은 “이번 점검 결과에 따른 환수와 문책 요구 등 후속 조치를 신속하게 실시하겠다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “보조금 편성·집행 등 제도를 더욱 투명하고 엄격하게 운영하고, 스마트 도시 사업이 실제 도시 문제를 해결하며 시민 편의를 증진하는 내실 있는 인프라를 만들어낼 수 있도록 적극 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Dong-young meets with US Korean Peninsula experts: "Close cooperation between South Korea and the US can resolve division and North Korean nuclear issue" (美 한반도 전문가들과 만난 정동영 “한미, 긴밀히 협력하면 분단·북핵 문제 해결 가능”)
item.description:
Jeong Dong-young meets with US Korean Peninsula experts: "Close cooperation between South Korea and the US can resolve division and North Korean nuclear issue" ( 美 한반도 전문가들과 만난 정동영 “한미, 긴밀히 협력하면 분단·북핵 문제 해결 가능” )

Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young met with US experts on the Korean Peninsula on the 21st and stated, "Over the past 70-plus years, South Korea has become a successful nation based on the South Korea-US alliance," adding, "If we overcome the challenges of the Korean Peninsula's division and North Korea's nuclear issue through continued close South Korea-US relations, South Korea can leap further as a global nation." (정동영 통일부 장관은 21일 미국의 한반도 전문가들과 만나 “지난 70여 년간 한미동맹을 바탕으로 한국은 성공적 국가가 됐다”며 “앞으로도 긴밀한 한미관계를 기반으로 한반도 분단과 북한 핵문제라는 도전을 극복하게 된다면 한국은 더욱 세계적인 국가로 도약할 수 있다”고 했다.)

According to the Ministry of Unification, Minister Jeong held a meeting on this day with US experts on the Korean Peninsula who visited South Korea, including former Acting US Ambassador to South Korea Joseph Yun, Hudson Institute Asia-Pacific Security Chair Patrick Cronin, Brookings Institution Asia Policy Research Center SK-Korea Foundation Chair Andrew Yeo, RAND Corporation Korea Chair Mee-yeon Oh, RAND Corporation Senior Security Policy Researcher Mark Cozad, and RAND Corporation Researcher Heino Klinck. (통일부에 따르면 정 장관은 이날 한국을 찾은 조셉 윤 전 주한 미국대사대리, 패트릭 크로닌 허드슨연구소 아시아태평양 안보 석좌,앤드류 여 브루킹스연구소 아시아정책연구센터 SK-코리아재단 석좌, 오미연 랜드 연구소 한국석좌, 마크 코자드 랜드 연구소 선임 안보정책 연구원, 하이노 클링크 랜드연구소 연구원 등 미국 내 한반도 전문가들과 간담회를 가졌다.)

The Ministry of Unification reported that Minister Jeong explained the recent situation on the Korean Peninsula at this meeting and requested interest in and support for the efforts to advance peace on the Korean Peninsula being pursued by the Lee Jae-myung administration. Minister Jeong said, "If the US and China are the G2 for global peace and stability, then South Korea and the US are the G2 for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula," and added, "If South Korea and the US share the same goals and solutions and cooperate closely, I have a positive expectation that the division and North Korean nuclear issue, though difficult, are solvable tasks." (이 자리에서 정 장관은 최근의 한반도 정세를 설명하며 이재명 정부가 추진중인 한반도 평화 진전 노력에 대한 관심과 지지를 당부했다고 통일부는 전했다. 정 장관은 “미국과 중국이 세계의 평화와 안정을 위한 G2라면 한반도의 평화와 안정을 위한 G2는 한국과 미국”이라며 “한국과 미국이 같은 목표와 해법을 공유하고 긴밀히 협력한다면 분단과 북핵 문제 역시 어렵지만 해결 가능한 과제라는 긍정적 기대를 가지고 있다”고 했다.)

The Ministry of Unification explained that participants in the meeting exchanged various assessments of the recent situation on the Korean Peninsula and the North Korean nuclear issue, along with opinions on the possibility of resuming North Korea-US dialogue and realistic solutions to the North Korean nuclear issue. They also shared that discussions on the need for a more realistic and effective approach amid the changing security environment are taking place within the US policy community. (간담회 참석자들은 최근 한반도 정세와 북핵 문제에 대한 다양한 평가와 함께, 북·미대화 재개 가능성 및 현실적 북핵 해법 등에 대해 의견을 나눴다고 통일부는 설명했다. 또 최근 미국 내 정책 커뮤니티에서도 변화된 안보 환경 속에서 보다 현실적이고 실효적인 접근 필요성에 대한 논의가 이루어지고 있다는 점을 공유했다고 한다.)

The Ministry of Unification stated, "We plan to continue efforts for peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula while closely communicating with the US and the international community moving forward." (통일부는 “앞으로도 미국을 비롯한 국제사회와 긴밀히 소통하면서 한반도 평화공존을 위한 노력을 지속해 나갈 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Visits Café in Ikseon-dong: "That's Not Coffee, Is It?" (익선동 카페 찾은 李대통령 “거기 커피는 아니지요?”)
item.description:
President Lee Visits Café in Ikseon-dong: "That's Not Coffee, Is It?" (익선동 카페 찾은 李대통령 “거기 커피는 아니지요?”)

President Lee Jae-myung visited Dongui-dong's jjokbang village in Jongno-gu, Seoul on the 21st, and then went to Ikseon-dong's hanok street and Galmaegi (Seagull) Alley to greet citizens, according to Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung. (이재명 대통령은 21일 서울 종로구 돈의동 쪽방촌 방문 후 익선동 한옥거리와 갈매기 골목 등을 찾아 시민들과 인사를 나눴다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 밝혔다.)

President Lee had dinner with his entourage at a restaurant's outdoor seating and then visited a nearby coffee shop. After ordering a warm Americano via a kiosk, President Lee reportedly asked, "That's not coffee, is it?" This comment is interpreted as a jab at Starbucks Korea, which sparked controversy by holding a 'May 18 Tank Day' event on the 46th anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. The day prior, President Lee had said in a cabinet meeting, "Issues related to Gwangju's May 18 incident or its victims are often met with 'How can people in human guise do such things?'" <<> That day, a citizen eating samgyeopsal at a long-standing restaurant told President Lee, "I'm buying meat with the livelihood support fund." When another citizen inside the shop rushed out to request a photo, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, who was nearby, took the picture for them. <<> Tourists from countries like Uzbekistan and Japan requested photos, calling out "Mr. President," and greeted him warmly with phrases like "Nice to meet you" and "From Uzbekistan." President Lee initiated high-fives with students and took a group selfie himself, which he handed over, Spokesperson Kang reported. <<> Earlier, President Lee visited the rooms of residents in Dongui-dong's jjokbang village and talked with them about their health and living difficulties. When residents said, "Stay healthy," President Lee responded, "It's important that you mothers stay healthy." (이 대통령은 일행과 한 음식점 야장에서 저녁식사를 마치고 근처 커피 매장을 찾았다. 키오스크로 따뜻한 아메리카노를 주문한 이 대통령은 “거기 커피는 아니지요?”라고 묻기도 했다. 이는 5·18 민주화운동 46주년 당일에 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 이벤트를 벌여 논란이 된 스타벅스코리아를 겨냥한 발언으로 풀이된다. 이 대통령은 전날 국무회의에서 “광주 5·18 문제나 피해자들에 대해 ‘어떻게 사람의 탈을 쓰고 그럴 수 있나’ 이런 것들이 상당히 많이 벌어진다”고 했었다.)

item.title: Missionary Kim Hak-song, Once Detained in North Korea, Says "I Always Feel Sorry for Surviving Alone… Call for Release of Long-Term Detained Korean Missionaries" (北 억류됐던 김학송 선교사 “혼자 살아 나와 늘 미안함 마음…장기억류 韓 선교사 석방을”)
item.description:
Missionary Kim Hak-song, Once Detained in North Korea, Says "I Always Feel Sorry for Surviving Alone… Call for Release of Long-Term Detained Korean Missionaries" (北 억류됐던 김학송 선교사 “혼자 살아 나와 늘 미안함 마음…장기억류 韓 선교사 석방을”)

Kim Hak-song, a missionary who was detained by North Korea for one year starting in May 2017 and later released, said on the 21st, "Kim Jeong-wook, Kim Guk-gi, and Choi Chun-gil, three South Korean missionaries, are still being held in North Korea for over 10 years," adding, "I still can't sleep at times due to the guilt of having come out alive alone." (북한에 2017년 5월부터 1년간 억류됐다 석방된 김학송 선교사는 21일 “김정욱·김국기·최춘길 한국인 선교사 세 분이 10년 넘게 아직도 북한에 억류중”이라며 “혼자 살아 나왔다는 미안함에 아직도 잠이 안올 때가 있다”고 했다.)

Kim made these remarks while sharing his experience of detention in North Korea during an international conference held at Yonsei University under the theme "Bringing Home the Three South Korean Missionaries Detained in North Korea." Kim, who is active as a missionary in the United States, returned to South Korea to attend the conference. The event was co-hosted by the newly launched "National Association for Families of Detainees in North Korea," the Transitional Justice Working Group, and Yonsei University's Institute for East Asian Studies, with the families of the detained missionaries playing a central role. (김 선교사는 이날 연세대에서 열린 ‘북한억류 한국 선교사 3인을 집으로’라는 주제로 열린 국제회의에서 자신의 북한 억류 경험을 소개하며 이렇게 말했다. 미국에서 선교사로 활동중인 김 선교사는 이날 회의 참석을 위해 귀국했다. 이날 국제회의는 북한에 억류된 선교사 가족들을 중심으로 이날 공식 출범한 ‘북한억류국민가족회’와 전환기정의그룹, 연세대 동서문제연구원이 공동으로 주최했다.)

Kim said, "I still have nightmares at night due to the trauma of being kept in solitary confinement for a year in a North Korean prison, and because of that, I now have Parkinson's disease, which makes my speech a bit slurred and my movements slow." He added, "On May 6, 2017, I was leaving Pyongyang and was arrested at the airport. I was completely unaware of why I was being arrested." North Korea's Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) at the time publicly disclosed Kim's arrest and detention, citing "charges of engaging in hostile acts against the Republic (North Korea)." Kim had entered North Korea in 2014 as a technician in charge of a farm under the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences at Pyongyang University of Science and Technology and was arrested and detained by North Korean authorities at the airport while trying to return to his home in Dandong, China in May 2017. <<> Kim provided a detailed account of his harrowing detention experience on that day. He said, "On the first night in solitary confinement, dinner was served, but both the rice and the salted radish had mold on them. I couldn't eat it." The next day, an investigator from North Korea's State Security Department visited him and reportedly said, "If you don't eat, it will be considered defiance of Republic laws, and we will punish you more severely." Kim added, "The investigator threatened to bring my wife (from Dandong, China) if I didn't cooperate, so I was so afraid they might actually take her that I thought about banging my head on the desk and dying." <<> Kim recalled, "On the 39th day of my imprisonment, June 13, 2017, I was finally allowed to bathe. It was the first time I saw a mirror. My hair had turned completely white, and I didn't even recognize my own reflection." <<> Kim noted that during his detention in North Korea, he couldn't freely use the restroom. He said, "When I pressed the bell to request the bathroom, it took three rings for the investigator to come. By the time they arrived, I almost soiled my pants." He added, "Although I wasn't beaten because I'm a U.S. citizen, this was no different from torture. The prison was like a warehouse, and there were so many insects that when I tried to sleep, they would crawl into my ears and nose." <<> After Kim's first bath on the 39th day of his detention, North Korean investigators reportedly covered his head with a cloth and took him somewhere. Arriving on the second floor of what is believed to be the Koryo Hotel, they removed the cloth, and he found himself face-to-face with then U.S. Deputy Special Representative for North Korea Policy, Joseph Yun. Kim said, "At that time, I thought meeting a U.S. State Department official meant I would be released right away, but after a month with no news, I gave up hope. I had completely given up, but in May 2018, then-Secretary of State Mike Pompeo came to North Korea and brought me and others out. Then-President Donald Trump came into the plane and his first words to us were, 'You are America's heroes.'" <<> At the international conference, Kim Jeong-sam, the brother of Kim Jeong-wook, who was detained in North Korea in October 2013, said, "The fact that the international community still remembers the issue of our nationals' detention is a great comfort and hope for the families. As time passes, the families of the detainees are aging and falling ill; our father and older brother have already passed away." He appealed, "I earnestly ask the international community: please help us at least confirm the life status and health conditions of the missionaries detained in North Korea. Let the families hear news of them and at least exchange letters." <<> Choi Jin-young, the son of missionary Choi Chun-gil, who was detained in 2014, said, "My father, missionary Choi Chun-gil, dedicated his entire life to those suffering in the most neglected and lowly places. His entire belief was about sharing bread with the hungry and caring for the sick in the shadows beyond borders." Choi added, "As his child, I look toward where my father is and feel pain every day, as if standing before a giant wall. I have never forgotten my father, not even for a single day." He then said, "Isn't the basic duty of a state to protect the lives and safety of its people? I beg you all here with tears in my eyes: please raise your voices in solidarity until the three detained missionaries can face their families again." <<> The international conference was attended by Gabriella Citroni, Chair of the UN Working Group on Enforced or Involuntary Disappearances (WGEID), along with officials from international human rights organizations. The WGEID had previously determined that the deprivation of liberty of the missionaries detained in North Korea constitutes arbitrary detention contrary to international human rights norms, calling on North Korean authorities for immediate release, compensation, and an independent investigation. At the meeting, Chairperson Citroni stated, "Enforced disappearance is not just a personal issue; it affects not only the disappeared individuals but also their families, and the fact that such cases occur creates a sense of fear in society. The WGEID has repeatedly urged North Korean authorities to confirm the life status and release the detained missionaries, but they have never responded to our requests even once." <<> Currently, aside from the three missionaries—Kim Jeong-wook, Kim Guk-gi, and Choi Chun-gil—there are four North Korean defectors detained in North Korea, including Ko Hyun-chul, Kim Won-ho, Park Jeong-ho, and Ham Jin-woo, bringing the total number of South Korean nationals held there to seven. (김 선교사는 “아직도 북한 감옥에 1년 동안 독방에 있을때 겪은 트라우마 때문에 밤에 악몽을 꾸고 그때일로 현재 파킨슨병이 와서 말이 좀 어눌하고 행동도 굼뜬다”며 “2017년 5월6일 평양에서 나오다가 (공항에서) 체포당했는데 체포당할 때 왜 나를 체포하는지 그 이유도 전혀 모른채 체포당했다”고 했다. 북한 조선중앙통신은 당시 김 선교사의 체포·억류 사실을 공개하면서 “공화국(북한) 적대행위를 강행한 혐의”라고 했다. 김 선교사는 2014년 평양과학기술대 농생명학부 농장 담당 기술자로 북한에 입국했다 2017년 5월 평양에서 중국 단둥 집으로 돌아가려다 공항에서 북한 당국에 체포·억류됐다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "Park Min-sik and Jang Dong-hyuk's Goal Is to Trip Me Up and Elect the Democratic Party" (한동훈 “박민식·장동혁, 제 발목 잡아 민주당 당선시키는 게 목표”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: "Park Min-sik and Jang Dong-hyuk's Goal Is to Trip Me Up and Elect the Democratic Party" (한동훈 “박민식·장동혁, 제 발목 잡아 민주당 당선시키는 게 목표”)

Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running in the by-election for the Busan Buk-gu Gap National Assembly seat, stated at his campaign launch on the 21st, "I will ensure Buk-gu receives compensation for its lost 20 years." In response to People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik's earlier criticism labeling him a 'traitor' at his own launch, Han shot back, "Their goal is to trip me up and get Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo elected." <<> At his campaign launch held at Ssamji Park in Busan's Buk-gu, Han declared, "I will make Buk-gu the top priority and a true first-class district it has never been able to enjoy. I'm not here to build my own foothold in Buk-gu. I, Han Dong-hoon, will become Buk-gu's foothold." <<> He then questioned, "Over the past 20 years, during the era of Jeon Jae-soo and Park Min-sik, has Buk-gu developed to a satisfactory level?" adding, "Isn't it someone who drained the place dry and left now trying to use Buk-gu as a stepping stone?" This was an indirect criticism of Park, who left Busan's Buk-gu to run in the Seoul metropolitan area. <<> Targeting Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, Han said, "Buk-gu doesn't need AI; it needs AS (after-service) for the 20 years of loss and lack of development. I am the one who will thoroughly provide that AS for Buk-gu to the very end." <<> Earlier, at his own campaign launch, Park Min-sik shaved his head and attacked, "Han is a cruel traitor. How can we unite with a traitor?" In response, Han met with reporters after his launch and commented, "It seems clear that Park's stance is to block Han Dong-hoon even if it means Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo wins." He then added, "Can we reclaim power for conservatives with the same mindset as 'Yoon Again'? We'll just hand over the next administration too." <<> Pointing at Park, Han said, "His goal is simply to trip me up and get Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo elected, because he knows he won't win himself." He continued, "Park and Representative Jang Dong-hyuk seem to clearly take the position that they must block Han Dong-hoon even if Ha Jung-woo wins. Is that what being conservative is?" <<> Attending Han's campaign launch that day was honorary election committee chairperson Seo Byeong-soo, who had left the People Power Party. Others present included honorary election committee chairs Son Sang-yong and Jo Seong-ho, former lawmaker Jeong Mi-kyung, and Bumsaryeon (Alliance of Civic Groups), a conservative-leaning group. (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보가 21일 출정식에서 “북구의 잃어버린 20년을 보상받게 해드릴 것”이라고 밝혔다. 국민의힘 박민식 후보가 앞선 출정식에서 자신을 ‘배신자’라고 비판한 데 대해서 “제 발목을 잡아서 더불어민주당 하정우 후보를 당선시키는 게 목표”라고 맞받았다.)

item.title: "Absolutely No Unification with Han Dong-hoon" – People Power Party’s Park Min-shik Shaves Head at Campaign Rally (“한동훈과 단일화 결단코 없다” 국힘 박민식, 출정식서 삭발)
item.description:
"Absolutely No Unification with Han Dong-hoon" – People Power Party’s Park Min-shik Shaves Head at Campaign Rally (“한동훈과 단일화 결단코 없다” 국힘 박민식, 출정식서 삭발 )

Park Min-shik, the People Power Party candidate for the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, shaved his head at a campaign rally on the 21st, declaring, "There will be absolutely no unification." Immediately after shaving his head, Park stated, "This fight is to put an end to the betrayal of the arrogant independent candidate Han Dong-hoon and to defeat Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party, who is full of hypocrisy," adding, "My epitaph only needs to read 'Park Min-shik of Buk-gu.'" (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 국민의힘 박민식 후보가 21일 출정식에서 “단일화는 결단코 없다”면서 삭발했다. 박 후보는 이날 삭발 직후 “이번 싸움은 오만한 한동훈(무소속) 후보의 배신을 끝장내고, 위선으로 가득 찬 더불어민주당 하정우 후보를 꺾기 위한 것”이라며 “제 묘비명은 ‘북구 사람 박민식’이면 충분하다”고 했다.)

At the rally held at Ssambawi Park in Buk-gu, Busan, Park said, "Today, I declare this my final campaign rally, staking my political life." Regarding his decision to shave his head, he explained, "I cut it to remind myself of my resolve to throw this body into the fight—not to gain cheap sympathy votes, but as an attitude of desperate resistance." Park’s mother personally shaved his head. (박 후보는 이날 부산 북구 쌈지공원에서 열린 출정식에서 “오늘은 제 정치 생명을 건 최후의 출정식이라고 선언한다”고 했다. 삭발을 결정한 배경에 대해선 “이 한 몸 던지겠다는 각오를 저 자신에게 주기 위해서 깎겠다”며 “싸구려 동정표를 얻기 위한 것이 아니라 결사항전의 태도”라고 설명했다. 박 후보의 머리는 모친이 직접 깎았다.)

On the issue of unification with Han Dong-hoon, which has been raised within the People Power Party, Park said, "Absolutely not. I will go all the way and win for sure. Even if I have to shave my head, I will never tolerate the politics of betrayal, plunder, and parasitism taking root in our Buk-gu." Targeting Han, he called him a "cruel traitor" and asked, "How can I unify with a traitor?" (국민의힘 당내에서 제기되는 한동훈 후보와의 단일화와 관련해서 박 후보는 “결단코 없다. 끝까지 가서 반드시 이긴다”며 “머리를 밀지언정, 배신과 약탈·기생의 정치가 우리 북구에 발붙이는 일은 결코 용납하지 않겠다”고 했다. 한 후보를 겨냥해서 “잔인한 배신자”라며 “어떻게 배신자와 단일화가 되겠나”라고 했다.)

On this day, Park focused more on criticizing independent candidate Han Dong-hoon than on Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo. Park said, "The moment I accept Han, it triggers the devastation of conservatism, the plunder of Buk-gu, and the birth of the Democratic Party’s parasitic path. That isn’t unification—it’s a self-harming act that hands over our Buk-gu intact to Ha Jung-woo of the Democratic Party." He then fiercely attacked, saying, "How can such a person talk about reinstatement? That itself is a disgrace to conservatism and a deception that drives conservatism to ruin." <<> Park's campaign rally was attended by floor leader Song Eon-seok, lawmakers Ahn Cheol-soo, Kim Min-jeon, and Park Seong-hoon, and former lawmaker Kim Woong. Floor leader Song said, "True conservative reconstruction means increasing the number of People Power Party seats in the National Assembly to put a brake on the dictatorship of Lee Jae-myung’s regime and the Democratic Party." Lawmaker Ahn, regarding the Democratic Party’s push for a special counsel law on alleged 'fabricated indictments' that could allow the cancellation of charges against President Lee, said, "If the Democratic Party takes over local governments as well, they will eventually completely eliminate the president’s trials." (이날 박 후보는 민주당 하정우 후보보다는 무소속 한동훈 후보 비판에 상대적으로 집중했다. 박 후보는 “한 후보를 용납하는 순간 보수 초토화, 북구 약탈, 민주당 기생의 길이 탄생한다”며 “그건 단일화가 아니라 우리 북구를 민주당 하정우에게 고스란히 상납하는 자해 행위”라고 했다. 이어 “이런 자가 어떻게 복당 운운하나. 그 자체가 보수의 치욕이며 보수를 파멸로 몰아넣는 기만”이라고 거칠게 공세했다.)

item.title: Park Pledges to Increase Average Citizen Salary by 32%; Yoo to Double ‘1,000-Won Housing’ Supply Yearly (朴 “시민 평균연봉 32% 높일 것” 劉 “천원주택 年 2배 확대”)
item.description:
Park Pledges to Increase Average Citizen Salary by 32%; Yoo to Double ‘1,000-Won Housing’ Supply Yearly (朴 “시민 평균연봉 32% 높일 것” 劉 “천원주택 年 2배 확대”)

In the June 3 Incheon mayoral election, Park Chan-dae (59), former Democratic Party floor leader, will face off against incumbent Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok (69) of the People Power Party. Lee Gi-bung (63), chairman of the Incheon chapter of the Reform Party, has also thrown his hat into the ring. (6·3 인천시장 선거에선 더불어민주당 박찬대(59) 전 민주당 원내대표와 국민의힘 유정복(69) 현 시장이 맞붙는다. 개혁신당 이기붕(63) 인천시당 위원장도 도전장을 냈다.)

In the three Incheon mayoral elections held since 2014, the candidate from the ruling party at the time has won each time. A local political insider commented, "Incheon has seen successive new towns like Songdo, Cheongna, Yeongjong, and Geomdan, leading to strong demands for infrastructure expansion such as transportation networks." They added, "This seems to have created a tendency to favor candidates from the ruling party." However, Yoo's camp argues that the city's positive response to his initiatives during his tenure—such as 100 million won support for families with newborns, ‘1,000-won housing’ for newlyweds, and ferry fare subsidies—means the outcome remains to be seen. (2014년 이후 치러진 세 차례 인천시장 선거에선 전부 선거 당시 여당 후보가 당선됐다. 지역 정치권 관계자는 “인천은 송도, 청라, 영종, 검단 등 신도시가 잇따라 조성돼 교통망 등 인프라 확충 요구가 강하다”며 “이 때문에 여당 후보를 선호하는 경향이 생긴 것 같다”고 했다. 다만 유 시장 측에선 재임 중 추진한 출생아 가구 1억원 지원, 신혼부부 ‘천원 주택’, 여객선 요금 지원 등에 대한 시민 호응이 컸다며 결과를 지켜봐야 한다고 주장한다.)

Former floor leader Park Chan-dae served as a three-term lawmaker for Yeonsu-gu Gap in Incheon. He is considered a key figure in the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction, having served as a supreme council member and floor leader when Lee Jae-myung was head of the Democratic Party. Park stated, "I will communicate with the president, the government, and the legislature to resolve city affairs." (박찬대 전 원내대표는 인천 연수구갑 선거구에서 3선 국회의원을 했다. 이재명 대통령이 민주당 대표를 할 때 최고위원, 원내대표 등으로 활동하는 등 친명계 핵심 인사로 꼽힌다. 박 전 원내대표는 “대통령, 정부, 입법부와 소통하며 시정을 풀어갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok served as a three-term lawmaker for Gimpo, Gyeonggi Province, and held positions as Minister of Security and Public Administration and Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. Yoo emphasized, "What a mayor needs are not words and promises, but experience and results," adding, "I aim to move forward toward a bigger dream alongside the citizens." (유정복 시장은 경기 김포 선거구에서 3선 국회의원을 했고 안전행정부 장관, 농림수산식품부 장관 등을 지냈다. 유 시장은 “시장에게 필요한 건 말과 약속이 아니라 경험과 성과”라며 “시민과 함께 더 큰 꿈을 향해 나아가려고 한다”고 했다.)

Former floor leader Park pledged, "By fostering new industries, I will raise the average annual salary of Incheon citizens to 55 million won by 2030." He aims to boost the current average salary of 41.8 million won by 32% through developing sectors like artificial intelligence (AI), biotechnology, K-culture, and energy. Specific plans include establishing the Incheon Institute of Biotechnology to nurture biotech talent and remodeling the Munhak Stadium into a "K-Culture Stadium" for K-pop performances. (박 전 원내대표는 “신산업을 육성해 2030년 인천 시민의 평균 연봉을 5500만원까지 끌어올리겠다”고 했다. 인공지능(AI)과 바이오, K컬처(문화), 에너지 등 산업을 키워 현재 4180만원 수준인 인천 시민 평균 연봉을 32% 올리겠다는 것이다. 구체적으로 바이오 인재를 길러내는 인천바이오과학기술원을 설립하고 문학경기장을 K팝 공연장으로 활용할 수 있는 ‘K컬처 스타티움’으로 리모델링하겠다고 했다.)

Mayor Yoo has put forward the "Completion of a 1,000-Won Universe for Incheon Citizens" as a key pledge, aiming to strengthen the welfare net through various "1,000-won policies." He announced doubling the annual supply of "1,000-won housing"—where newlyweds can live for up to six years paying just 1,000 won per day (30,000 won per month)—from 1,000 to 2,000 households. He also plans to introduce a "1,000-won pass" allowing unlimited public transit for a monthly fee of 30,000 won. (유 시장은 ‘인천 시민 전용 천원 유니버스 완성’을 대표 공약으로 내세우고 있다. 각종 ‘천원 정책’으로 복지망을 강화하겠다는 것이다. 신혼부부가 하루 1000원(한 달 3만원)으로 최대 6년까지 살 수 있는 ‘천원 주택’ 공급 규모를 연간 1000가구에서 2000가구로 늘리겠다고 밝혔다. 한 달 3만원만 내면 대중교통을 무제한 이용할 수 있는 ‘천원 패스’도 도입한다는 계획이다.)

In a survey conducted by Jo Won C&I for Gyeonggi Ilbo on May 14–15 (using ARS methodology), former floor leader Park received 48.6% support, while Mayor Yoo received 38.5%. The survey involved 802 Incheon citizens, with a response rate of 7.4% and a margin of error of ±3.5 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) In another survey by Poll Flower on April 28–29 with 1,003 Incheon citizens, Park received 54.9% and Yoo 29.5%, with a response rate of 6.5% and a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) (조원씨앤아이가 경기일보 의뢰로 지난 14~15일 실시한 지지도 조사(ARS 방식)에서 박 전 원내대표는 48.6%, 유 시장은 38.5%였다. 이 조사엔 인천시민 802명이 참여했다. 응답률은 7.4%, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.5%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 참조) 여론조사꽃이 지난달 28~29일 인천시민 1003명을 대상으로 실시한 지지도 조사에선 박 전 원내대표 54.9%, 유 시장 29.5%였다. 응답률은 6.5%, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.1%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 참조))

Clashes between the two sides have intensified recently. On May 19, Park's camp raised suspicions that Mayor Yoo had omitted 21,000 virtual assets (worth 100 million won) belonging to his spouse from the candidate's property declaration. In response, Yoo's camp explained, "The mayor's spouse managed those virtual assets on behalf of the mayor's older brother using his money," adding, "We judged it was not subject to property reporting." (최근 양측의 공방이 치열해지고 있다. 박 전 원내대표 측은 지난 19일 유 시장이 배우자의 가상자산 2만1000개(1억원 상당)를 후보자 재산에서 누락했다는 의혹을 제기했다. 이에 대해 유 시장 측은 “유 시장 배우자가 유 시장의 형님 돈으로 산 가상자산을 대신 관리한 것”이라며 “재산 신고 대상이 아니라고 판단했다”고 해명했다.)

A conflict also erupted when former floor leader Park posted on Facebook on May 14, "Are you asking if I’ll turn Incheon into Daejang-dong? Yes, I will." Mayor Yoo issued a statement criticizing it as "the worst reckless remark in election history." Park had previously stated in a Gyeonggi Ilbo interview on May 10, "President Lee’s Daejang-dong model is Korea’s first integrated development approach and the start of a creative idea," prompting Yoo to demand an apology, asking, "Are you saying you want to turn Incheon into a city of corruption?" (박 전 원내대표가 지난 14일 페이스북에 “인천을 대장동으로 만들겠냐고요? 네, 하겠습니다”라고 써 양측이 충돌하기도 했다. 유 시장은 입장문을 내고 “역대 선거 사상 최악의 망언”이라고 비판했다. 박 전 원내대표는 앞서 지난 10일 경기일보 인터뷰에서 “이 대통령의 대장동 모델은 우리나라 최초의 결합 개발 방식이자 창의적인 아이디어의 시작”이라고 했고 유 시장은 “인천을 부정부패 도시로 만들겠다는 것이냐”며 사과를 요구했다.)

Opinions varied among citizens encountered on site. Taxi driver Im (57) said, "With the president doing well, having a ruling party candidate as mayor might bring in more budget." Merchant Kim (76) commented, "I hope Mayor Yoo gets elected and can properly finish the policies he has been pushing." (현장에서 만난 시민들의 의견은 다양했다. 택시 기사 임모(57)씨는 “대통령이 잘하고 있는 상황에서 여당 후보가 시장이 되면 예산도 많이 따올 것 같다”고 했다. 상인 김모(76)씨는 “유 시장이 당선돼 추진하던 정책을 잘 마무리하면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Seoul’s Historic Downtown Districts See Tight Rivalry Between Parties… Incumbent People Power Party District Mayors Seek Reelection, Opposition Challenges (역대 서울 도심 선거서 여야 팽팽… 국힘 현 구청장들 출마에 與 도전장)
item.description:
Seoul’s Historic Downtown Districts See Tight Rivalry Between Parties… Incumbent People Power Party District Mayors Seek Reelection, Opposition Challenges (역대 서울 도심 선거서 여야 팽팽… 국힘 현 구청장들 출마에 與 도전장)

Seoul’s Jongno, Jung, Dongdaemun, and Seodaemun districts are areas in northern Seoul where support for the ruling and opposition parties is closely balanced. Since the introduction of direct district mayor elections in 1995, the Democratic Party of Korea-affiliated candidates have won five times out of a total of eight elections in Jongno, Dongdaemun, and Seodaemun, while the People Power Party-affiliated candidates won three times. In Jung District, including by-elections, out of ten elections, each side has won five times. (서울 종로·중·동대문·서대문구는 서울의 강북 지역에서 여야 지지세가 팽팽한 곳이다. 종로·동대문·서대문구는 1995년 민선 구청장 선거가 시작된 후 총 8번의 선거에서 더불어민주당 계열이 5번, 국민의힘 계열이 3번 당선됐다. 중구는 재·보궐선거를 포함해 총 10번의 선거 중 양쪽이 각각 5번 승리했다.)

In the 2018 local elections, all four districts elected Democratic Party-affiliated district mayors, but in the 2022 local elections, all were won by the People Power Party. In this election, all four incumbent People Power Party district mayors are seeking reelection. (2018년 지방선거 땐 4곳 모두 민주당 소속 구청장이 당선됐지만, 2022년 지방선거에서는 전부 국민의힘이 당선됐다. 이번 선거에선 국민의힘 현 구청장 4명이 모두 재선에 도전한다.)

Jongno District, home to the Blue House and the Seoul Government Complex, is often referred to as the "Political Premier Address." Former Presidents Yun Bo-seon, Roh Moo-hyun, and Lee Myung-bak, as well as former Prime Ministers Lee Nak-yon and Chung Sye-kyun, have served as lawmakers from Jongno. In this district mayor election, Democratic Party candidate Yoo Chan-jong (67), a former Seoul city councilor, faces off against incumbent People Power Party Mayor Jeong Mun-heon (60). This is their second matchup following 2022. (청와대, 정부서울청사 등이 있는 종로구는 이른바 ‘정치 1번지’로 불린다. 윤보선·노무현·이명박 전 대통령과 이낙연·정세균 전 국무총리 등이 종로에서 국회의원을 지냈다. 이번 구청장 선거에서는 민주당 유찬종(67) 전 서울시의원과 국민의힘 정문헌(60) 현 구청장이 대결한다. 2022년에 이어 두 번째 매치다.)

Former city councilor Yoo pledged to "invest 30 billion won in traditional markets, jewelry, and garment industries to create a total of 8,000 jobs." Mayor Jeong is pushing real estate pledges, stating, "We will accelerate redevelopment and reconstruction projects at 31 sites to supply a total of 18,000 housing units." (유 전 시의원은 “전통시장·주얼리·봉제 산업 등에 300억원을 투입해 총 8000명을 고용할 것”이라고 공약했다. 정 구청장은 “31곳의 재건축·재개발을 본격화해 총 1만8000가구를 공급하겠다”며 부동산 공약을 앞세우고 있다.)

Jung District is the autonomous district with the smallest population in Seoul, with 117,760 registered residents as of last month. It is densely packed with major downtown business districts like Seoul City Hall and Euljiro, as well as tourist attractions such as Myeongdong and Cheonggyecheon. In this district mayor election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Dong-hyun (35), a former Seoul city councilor; People Power Party incumbent Mayor Kim Gil-seong (60); and Reform Party candidate Gil Ki-young (66), a Jung district councilor, are running. (중구는 서울에서 인구가 가장 적은 자치구다. 지난달 기준 등록 인구 수가 11만7760명이다. 서울시청, 을지로 등 주요 도심 업무 지구와 명동, 청계천 등 관광지가 밀집해 있다. 이번 구청장 선거에는 민주당 이동현(35) 전 서울시의원, 국민의힘 김길성(60) 현 구청장, 개혁신당 길기영(66) 중구의원이 출마했다.)

Former city councilor Lee and Mayor Kim share a common background as former aides to lawmakers representing Jung District (formerly Seoul Jung–Seongdong B). Lee served as an aide to current lawmaker Park Seong-jun, while Kim worked for former lawmaker Ji Sang-wook. (이 전 시의원과 김 구청장은 전·현 중구(서울 중·성동을) 국회의원의 보좌관 출신이라는 공통점이 있다. 이 전 시의원은 박성준 현 의원, 김 구청장은 지상욱 전 의원의 보좌관을 지냈다.)

In Dongdaemun and Seodaemun districts, rematches similar to Jongno District are taking place. (동대문·서대문구에서도 종로구와 마찬가지로 재대결이 펼쳐진다.)

In the Dongdaemun District mayor election, Democratic Party candidate Choi Dong-min (57), a former presidential administrative secretary, faces incumbent People Power Party Mayor Lee Pil-hyung (67). Key issues include redevelopment projects in areas like Cheongnyangni and Jeonnong-dong, as well as expanding the operation of the Suin–Bundang Line’s Cheongnyangni–Wangsimni section. (동대문구청장 선거에는 민주당 최동민(57) 전 대통령비서실 행정관과 국민의힘 이필형(67) 현 구청장이 출마했다. 청량리·전농동 등 재개발과 수인분당선 청량리~왕십리 구간 운행 확대 등이 주요 현안으로 꼽힌다.)

In the Seodaemun District mayor election, Democratic Party candidate Park Woon-ki (59), a former Seoul city councilor, competes against incumbent People Power Party Mayor Lee Seong-heon (68). Both former city councilor Park and Mayor Lee have made major pledges centered on local issues, such as opening the Seobu Line and Gangbuk Transversal Line, and promoting redevelopment in Bukahyeon-dong and Hongje-dong. (서대문구청장 선거에선 민주당 박운기(59) 전 서울시의원과 국민의힘 이성헌(68) 현 구청장이 맞붙는다. 박 전 시의원과 이 구청장 모두 지역 현안인 서부선·강북횡단선 개통, 북아현동·홍제동 재개발 추진 등을 주요 공약으로 냈다.)

item.title: Everyone Dons Blue… First Unified Education Superintendent Election (너도나도 파란 옷 입고… 첫 통합교육감 도전장)
item.description:
Everyone Dons Blue… First Unified Education Superintendent Election (너도나도 파란 옷 입고… 첫 통합교육감 도전장)

In the June 3 election for the superintendent of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City education office, four candidates are in the race: Kang Sook-young (64), Chair of the Carbon Neutral Committee of the Kim Dae-jung Foundation’s South Jeolla branch; Kim Dae-jung (65), the current South Jeolla Provincial Education Superintendent; Lee Jung-sun (67), the current Gwangju Metropolitan City Education Superintendent; and Jang Kwan-ho (58), former head of the South Jeolla branch of the Korean Teachers and Education Workers Union (KTU). All are progressive-leaning candidates. (6·3 전남광주통합특별시 교육감 선거에선 강숙영(64) 김대중재단 전남지부 탄소중립위원장과 김대중(65) 현 전남도교육감, 이정선(67) 현 광주광역시교육감, 장관호(58) 전 전교조 전남지부장이 4파전을 벌인다. 모두 진보 성향 후보다.)

Gwangju City and South Jeolla Province will merge into the "South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City" in July, and the education office will also be reestablished as the South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City Education Office. (광주시와 전남도가 오는 7월 ‘전남광주통합특별시’로 통합하면서 교육청도 전남광주통합특별시 교육청으로 출범한다.)

The annual budget of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Education Office will be approximately 7.27 trillion won. It will become the third-largest education office in the country, following the Gyeonggi Provincial and Seoul Metropolitan Education Offices. The office will oversee about 51,400 staff and approximately 347,700 students. In this election, both Kim Dae-jung, seeking reelection as South Jeolla Education Superintendent, and Lee Jung-sun, Gwangju Education Superintendent, are running. (전남광주통합교육청은 1년 예산이 약 7조2700억원이다. 경기도교육청, 서울시교육청에 이어 셋째로 큰 교육청이 된다. 교육청 산하 교직원은 약 5만1400명, 학생 수는 약 34만7700명이다. 이번 선거엔 재선을 노리는 김대중 전남교육감과 이정선 광주교육감이 모두 출마했다.)

Education Superintendent Kim Dae-jung began his teaching career in 1984 at Jeongmyeong Girls’ High School in Mokpo but was dismissed for his activities with the KTU. He later served three terms as a Mokpo city councilor, council chair, and as chief of staff for former South Jeolla Education Superintendent Jang Man-chae. He was elected South Jeolla Education Superintendent in the 2022 local elections. In 2024, he introduced the nation’s first "South Jeolla Student Education Allowance," providing monthly points worth 100,000 won for elementary school students and 50,000 won for middle school 1st and 2nd graders, usable at bookstores and academies. On the 21st, Superintendent Kim stated, "I will fully expand the proven student education allowance from South Jeolla to Gwangju." He also pledged to create a scholarship fund worth 1.5 trillion won. (김대중 교육감은 1984년 목포 정명여고에서 교직을 시작했으나 전교조 활동을 하다 해직됐다. 이후 3선 목포시의원과 시의장, 장만채 전남교육감 비서실장 등을 지냈다. 2022년 지방선거에서 전남교육감에 당선됐다. 2024년 전국 최초로 ‘전남 학생 교육수당’을 도입했다. 초등학생에게는 매월 10만원, 중학교 1·2학년에게는 매월 5만원 상당의 포인트를 준다. 포인트는 서점·학원 등에서 쓸 수 있다. 김 교육감은 21일 “전남에서 검증된 학생 교육수당을 광주까지 전면 확대하겠다”고 했다. 1조5000억원 규모의 장학기금도 조성하겠다고 공약했다.)

Education Superintendent Lee Jung-sun is a former professor who served as president of Gwangju National University of Education from 2012 to 2016. She was elected Gwangju Education Superintendent in 2022. Superintendent Lee stated, "I will build a 'one-on-one AI (artificial intelligence) home tutor' infrastructure across the Gwangju and South Jeolla region." This one-on-one AI home tutor is a 'digital tutoring' service where AI analyzes students' learning levels and provides tailored content. She said, "It will help reduce the burden of private education costs and bridge the educational gap between regions." She also announced plans to attract edtech (advanced educational technology) startups to develop the unified special city into a "K-EdTech Special City." (이정선 교육감은 2012~2016년 광주교대 총장을 지낸 교수 출신이다. 2022년 광주교육감에 당선됐다. 이 교육감은 “광주·전남 전 지역에 ‘일대일 AI(인공지능) 가정교사’ 인프라를 구축하겠다”고 했다. 일대일 AI 가정교사는 AI가 학생의 학습 수준 등을 분석해 맞춤형 콘텐츠를 제공하는 ‘디지털 과외’ 서비스다. 이 교육감은 “사교육비 부담을 줄이고 지역간 교육 격차를 해소하는 데 도움이 될 것”이라고 했다. 에듀테크(첨단교육기술) 스타트업을 유치해 통합특별시를 ‘K-에듀테크 특별시’로 육성하겠다는 계획도 밝혔다.)

Chair Kang Sook-young has served as a teacher, principal, and superintendent of the South Jeolla Provincial Education Office. Chair Kang stated, "I will push for a school system reform to have 5 years of elementary, 4 years of middle, and 3 years of high school," arguing that the current system, in place for over 70 years, does not reflect children's rapid growth rates. She also said, "I will make carbon neutrality a core value of education." (강숙영 위원장은 교사와 교장, 전남도교육청 장학관 등을 거쳤다. 강 위원장은 “초등학교 5학년·중학교 4학년·고등학교 3학년으로 학제 개편을 추진하겠다”고 했다. 70여 년 된 현행 학제가 아이들의 빠른 성장 속도를 반영하지 못한다는 것이다. “탄소 중립을 교육의 핵심 가치로 삼겠다”고도 했다.)

Candidate Jang Kwan-ho, a former teacher, served as the head of the South Jeolla branch of the KTU. On the 18th, eight former education superintendents, including former Gwangju Superintendent Jang Hwi-guk, declared their support for Candidate Jang. Candidate Jang stated, "I will restore the collapsed public education and establish a clean educational administration system." He also said, "I will strengthen democratic civic education that upholds historical values." (장관호 위원은 교사 출신으로 전교조 전남지부장을 지냈다. 장휘국 전 광주교육감 등 전직 교육감 8명이 지난 18일 장 위원 지지를 선언했다. 장 위원은 “무너진 공교육을 바로 세우고 청렴한 교육 행정 시스템을 구축하겠다”고 했다. “역사의 가치를 지키는 민주시민교육을 강화하겠다”고도 했다.)

In a poll commissioned by News 1’s Gwangju-South Jeolla bureau and conducted by Gallup Korea on the 16th and 17th, Superintendent Kim Dae-jung received 31%, Superintendent Lee Jung-sun 17%, Candidate Jang Kwan-ho 15%, and Chair Kang Sook-young 6%. The survey involved 1,002 men and women aged 18 and over living in Gwangju and South Jeolla. It was conducted via telephone interviewer-assisted interviews (CATI). The response rate was 16.2%, and the margin of error is ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) A local education official said, "The undecided vote is over 30%, making it difficult to predict the election outcome." (뉴스1 광주전남취재본부가 한국갤럽에 의뢰해 지난 16~17일 실시한 지지도 조사에서 김대중 교육감은 31%, 이정선 교육감은 17%, 장관호 위원은 15%, 강숙영 위원장은 6%였다. 이 조사엔 광주·전남에 사는 만 18세 이상 남녀 1002명이 참여했다. 전화 조사원 인터뷰(CATI) 방식으로 진행됐다. 응답률은 16.2%, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.1%포인트다.(중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 참조) 지역 교육계 관계자는 “부동층이 30%가 넘어 선거 결과를 예상하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

Park (62), a merchant met on Chungjang-ro in Dong-gu, Gwangju on the 18th, said, "They're all dressed in blue, so I can't tell who is who," adding, "It's an education superintendent election, but I don't hear about policies, they're just bickering with each other." Park Eun-jeong (52), met at the Dongbu Market in Mokpo, said, "I don't think the unified special city's education will improve no matter who wins," adding, "I don't know why I should vote." Choi (42), a parent living in Yeosu, said, "The educational environment in Yeosu and Gwangju is like night and day," adding, "With the unified education office launching, not a single candidate is presenting a concrete vision for how to merge urban and rural education." Lee Kang-soo (45), from Punghyang-dong, Gwangju, said, "Watching the TV debate, they just demean and trash each other like politicians," adding, "I'm worried about entrusting our children's education to them." (지난 18일 광주 동구 충장로에서 만난 상인 박모(62)씨는 “전부 파란색 옷을 입고 다녀 누가 누군지 모르겠다”며 “교육감 선거인데 정책은 안 들리고 서로 쌈박질만 하고 있다”고 했다. 목포시 동부시장에서 만난 박은정(52)씨는 “누가 당선돼도 통합특별시 교육이 나아질 것 같지 않다”며 “왜 투표를 해야 하는지 모르겠다”고 했다. 여수에 사는 학부모 최모(42)씨는 “여수와 광주는 교육 환경이 천지 차이가 난다”며 “통합 교육청이 출범하는데 도시와 농어촌 교육을 어떻게 합칠지 구체적인 비전을 제시하는 후보가 한 명도 없다”고 말했다. 광주 풍향동에 사는 이강수(45)씨는 “TV 토론을 보니 정치인처럼 상대방을 비하하고 헐뜯기만 하더라”며 “우리 아이들 교육을 맡겨도 될지 걱정된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Same-Age Ex-CEOs... Jo Moon-gwan and Na Dong-yeon’s ‘Nakdong River Match’ (CEO 출신 동갑내기… 조문관·나동연 ‘낙동강 매치’)
item.description:
Same-Age Ex-CEOs... Jo Moon-gwan and Na Dong-yeon’s ‘Nakdong River Match’ (CEO 출신 동갑내기… 조문관·나동연 ‘낙동강 매치’ )

Yangsan, South Gyeongsang Province, is a central city in the eastern region of the province. It houses factories for companies like Korea Steel Co., Nexen Tire, Cuckoo Electronics, and Philip Morris. Its current population stands at 360,000. With the development of new towns in Mulgeum and Sasong, there has been a significant influx of new households from nearby Busan and Ulsan. It is the only city in South Gyeongsang Province experiencing population growth. (경남 양산은 경남 동부 지역의 중심 도시다. 고려제강과 넥센타이어, 쿠쿠전자, 필립모리스 등 공장이 몰려 있다. 현재 인구는 36만명. 물금·사송에 신도시가 조성되면서 근처 부산, 울산 등에서 새로 유입된 가구가 많다. 경남에서 유일하게 인구가 늘어나는 곳이다.)

Yangsan was once considered a conservative stronghold. However, after Democratic Party candidate Kim Il-kwon won the 2018 Yangsan mayoral election, it has been called part of the "Nakdong River Belt," where the ruling and opposition parties fiercely compete, along with Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, and Busan’s Buk-gu. Local political circles say, "President Moon Jae-in’s move to Pyeongsan Village in Yangsan after his retirement strengthened support for the Democratic Party." In last year’s presidential election, People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo received 46.65% of the vote, narrowly edging out Democratic Party candidate Lee Jae-myung (44.69%). <<> In this June 3rd election for Yangsan mayor, Democratic Party Vice Director of the Democracy Research Institute, Jo Moon-gwan (71), and current Yangsan mayor Na Dong-yeon (71) of the People Power Party, are facing off. <<> Both are born in 1955, same age, and have backgrounds as entrepreneurs. Vice Director Jo ran a machinery manufacturing company, while Mayor Na operated an environmental facility company. The two are said to be close friends. On the 11th, Vice Director Jo and Mayor Na signed a "Clean Election Practice Joint Agreement," pledging to "conduct a policy-focused election without slander." <<> Vice Director Jo won the Democratic Party primary, which had eight candidates. He was first elected as a Yangsan city council member as an independent in the 1998 local elections. He then became a South Gyeongsang provincial council member in the 2002 local elections as a candidate for the Grand National Party, the predecessor of the People Power Party. He ran for re-election in 2006 but failed to receive the Grand National Party nomination and lost as an independent. He subsequently challenged for the Yangsan mayoral seat in 2010 and 2014 but was pushed out by Mayor Na in the Grand National Party (Saenuri Party in 2014) primaries. Vice Director Jo switched his party affiliation to the Democratic Party in 2017 and has served as senior advisor for the Democratic Party in Yangsan’s Gap district. Vice Director Jo stated, "During Mayor Na’s three terms over 12 years, nothing in Yangsan has changed," adding, "A strong ruling party mayor can change Yangsan’s future." <<> Mayor Na is seeking a "stepping-stone fourth term." After serving two terms as a Yangsan city council member, he was first elected mayor of Yangsan in 2010. He was re-elected in the 2014 local elections. He lost in the 2018 local elections and challenged for a parliamentary seat in the 2020 general election, but faced defeat again. He then succeeded in winning a third term as Yangsan mayor in 2022. Mayor Na said, "Please give me the opportunity to deliver results on key projects, such as designating Hwangsan Park as a national garden, creating the Yangsan Arboretum, and developing the Jeungsan New Town." <<> Both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party are concentrating their efforts on the Yangsan mayoral election. For the Democratic Party, following party leader Jeong Cheong-rae’s visit to Yangsan in March, former South Gyeongsang Governor and current gubernatorial candidate Kim Kyoung-soo also visited the ‘Children’s Day Festival’ site held at Yangsan Sports Complex on the 5th. On the 17th, former Governor Kim and Vice Director Jo stated, "We will develop Yangsan into a hub city of the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam mega-city." For the People Power Party, current South Gyeongsang Governor and gubernatorial candidate Park Wan-soo, alongside Mayor Na on the 12th, announced a pledge to "cultivate Yangsan as an advanced logistics city centered on medical and bio-industries." Governor Park also visited the ‘Children’s Day Festival’ in Yangsan on the 5th, touring the area with Mayor Na. <<> The pledges of Vice Director Jo and Mayor Na regarding local issues are similar. Both have promised to construct a tunnel between Sangbuk and Ungsang. Yangsan is home to Cheonseong Mountain (920m above sea level) in the middle of the city, which divides the living zones east-west; they plan to connect these areas by building a tunnel. <<> The issue of Pusan National University’s Yangsan Campus, located in the heart of Mulgeum New Town, is another pending matter. While it was initially planned to relocate both the medical and engineering colleges from Busan to the Yangsan campus, only the medical college moved due to opposition from Busan residents. As a result, a 540,000㎡ site has remained barren for 20 years. In response, Vice Director Jo pledged to relocate Pusan National University’s engineering college back to the site. He said, "If the engineering college moves to Yangsan, the local industry will thrive, and Pusan National University’s competitiveness will increase." Mayor Na stated he would develop the site into a "biomedical R&D (research and development) complex." He explained, "By easing regulations on usage zones and similar restrictions, we will create a complex that integrates housing, parks, and research institutes." This site was previously selected as a candidate for the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport’s ‘Space Innovation Zone Leading Project’ in 2024. <<> In a favorability survey conducted by polling firm Innertek Systems for News Gyeongnam on the 16th and 17th, Mayor Na scored 45.7%, while Vice Director Jo scored 43.9%. The survey involved 1,012 Yangsan residents. It was conducted using an automated response system (ARS). The response rate was 5.5%, and the margin of error was ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission) (양산은 과거 보수 강세 지역으로 꼽혔다. 그러나 2018년 양산시장 선거에서 더불어민주당 김일권 후보가 당선된 이후 경남 김해, 부산 북구 등과 함께 여야가 격전을 벌이는 ‘낙동강 벨트’로 불린다. 지역 정치권에선 “문재인 대통령이 퇴임 후 양산 평산마을로 내려오면서 민주당 지지세가 강해졌다”는 말이 나온다. 지난해 대선 때는 국민의힘 김문수 후보가 46.65% 득표율을 얻어 민주당 이재명 후보(44.69%)를 근소하게 앞섰다.)
